contracts.declared_mechanism: Shared-secret header verification at the top of the handler: expected token read from the CALLBACK_TOKEN environment variable; HTTP 503 raised if CALLBACK_TOKEN is unset/empty; HTTP 401 raised if X-Callback-Token is missing or unequal to the expected token; the legitimate sender (local_bridge/callback_client.post_result_callback) sets the same header, and api_service provisions the token to the bridge via the demo-submit form field callback_token.
